title: The Blood Debt
logline: A broke cousin inherits a massive debt instead of a fortune, and hires a pilot to destroy the cartel's bounty hunters while they erase the records.

roles.description: Constantly panicking, extremely unlucky, owes everyone money.
Cheerful, polite, will break your legs with a smile.
A grim, heavily armored bureaucratic nightmare.
A heavily armed interceptor painted neon green.
A legal but utterly ruthless financial institution.

public_situation: The {role:debt_cartel} has declared the {role:broke_cousin} fully liable for their late uncle's multi-million credit debt.
private_truth: The cousin discovered a backdoor in the cartel's mainframe and is planning to delete the debt entirely, but they need a distraction.

beats.public_change: The cartel puts a massive bounty on the cousin's head.

missions.reason: The cousin asks the pilot to meet a bribed clerk at the processing center and collect the physical encryption keys for the mainframe.
missions.private_fact: The keys are guarded by automated turrets.

beats.public_change: The first wave of bounty hunters arrives in the system.

missions.reason: The cousin needs the pilot to deliver a custom data virus directly into the center's main terminal.
missions.private_fact: The virus doesn't just delete the cousin's debt; it deletes everyone's debt.

beats.public_change: The gravity tides spike, trapping everyone in the system just as the virus activates.

missions.reason: The cousin pays the pilot to destroy the cartel's lead bounty hunter so they can escape.
missions.private_fact: The loan shark hails the pilot, offering to clear all of the pilot's debts if they kill the cousin instead.

player_choice.prompt: The bounty hunter is dead. The loan shark is offering a clean slate if the pilot betrays the cousin.

options.label: Kill the cousin and take the deal

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot helps the cousin escape.
resolutions.summary: The virus wipes the cartel's records, causing a massive financial crash. The cousin escapes, completely debt-free, and the pilot is a folk hero.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot wiped out the sector's debt records and bankrupted a ruthless cartel.

resolutions.summary: The cousin is killed. The loan shark stops the virus just in time. The cartel maintains control, and the pilot's debts are erased.
The bounty hunters easily catch the cousin. The cousin is sold into indentured servitude to pay off the debt.

loose_threads.detail: The uncle didn't die naturally; he was assassinated by the cartel to trigger the debt transfer.
The cartel is actually funded by the planetary government to keep the lower classes impoverished.

radio_hooks: Debt collection intensified across the sector.
